events.title: 🚀Dark Sorcery Kickstarter Campaign Is Now Live!
events.summary: Hello everyone!Today is a very special day for us, the Dark Sorcery Kickstarter campaign is officially live!Over the past months, we've been hard at work improving the game based on your feedback. We've added a new playable world, new enemies, bosses, spells, UI improvements, balance changes, optimization, and many other features.
